metadata.title: Non-homogeneous curvature flows in a hemisphere
metadata.abstract: Let S^{n+1}_{+} be the open hemisphere of the unit sphere S^{n+1} centred at o. We study the non-homogeneous curvature flow X_t=-f(r) sigma_k^{alpha} {nu} of smooth, closed, strictly convex hypersurfaces enclosing o, where r is the geodesic distance to o. We consider both the supercritical regime beta>1+k {alpha} and the critical regime beta=1+k{alpha}, where beta is the growth order of the profile at the origin, f(r) almost equals r^{beta} as r descends to 0. Under the structural condition that f^{1/(1+k{alpha})} is convex, we prove long-time existence and preservation of strict convexity. The normalized radial function converges smoothly and exponentially to a constant: to 1 and to R_{infty}>0, resp. in different two cases. Thus the normalized radial graphs become round, while the original hypersurfaces contract to o.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 半球中非齐次曲率流的渐近圆化
analysis.workSummary: 研究带径向系数的 sigma_k 幂曲率流，在超临界及临界增长条件下证明长期存在、严格凸性保持及归一化径向图的光滑指数收敛。
analysis.breakthrough: 明确径向系数增长影响收缩尺度及圆化极限的方式。
analysis.limitations: 要求初始严格凸且包围中心，并假设系数的指定幂凸性；两种增长情形极限常数不同。 当前为摘要级数学分析，主结果和证明尚未逐段核查；AI 披露另见独立核查记录。
analysis.priorityReason: 参数分界与指数收敛可与齐次流比较，值得曲率流方向核对。
